item.title: NASA Pilot Pulls Off the Smoothest No Wheels, No Brakes Landing You’ll Ever See
item.description: One morning about a week ago turned into an unexpected aviation nail-biter when a NASA pilot brought a WB-57 aircraft down at Ellington Airport in Houston with the landing gear refusing to deploy. No wheels, no brakes, and a very long stretch of concrete standing between success and disaster. Somehow, the pilot eased the aircraft onto the runway and slid it to a stop without anyone getting hurt. item.title: Sundance Review: UNDERTONE Creates a Haunting Auditory Nightmare
item.description: I’m obsessed with all things horror, and podcasts are no exception. If I’m by myself, it doesn’t matter what I’m doing, chances are I’m listening to a podcast about either true crime or ghost stories. I even have a selection of ghost story podcasts that help me fall asleep. So when I heard about the new A24 acquisition, Undertone, I was pretty excited. The film follows Evy (Nina Kiri,) the host of a popular paranormal podcast, as she cares for her catatonic mother who is at the end of her life.
